title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of 28-Day Mortality in Patients with Sepsis-Induced Cardiomyopathy: An Integrated Analysis of Inflammatory Biomarkers.
summary: Machine-learning models trained on 762 ICU patients with sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy predicted 28-day mortality; evaluation was internal and the authors call for multicenter external validation.
ai_technology: A machine-learning model predicts 28-day mortality in ICU patients with sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy.
organization: Department of Cardiology, Zhongda Hospital, School of Medicine, Southeast University, Nanjing, Jiangsu, 210009, People's Republic of China; Department of Geriatric Cardiology, Jinling Hospital, Affiliated Hospital of Medical School, Nanjing University, NanJing, Jiangsu, 210002, People's Republic of China

evidence.tested: Internal evaluation of 762 ICU patients; multicenter external validation is still needed.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning model predicts 28-day mortality in ICU patients with sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
